pages.text: The $(item)Liquid Sponge$() clears every nearby liquid, not just water (lava becomes fire). $(item)Liquid Sponge on a Stick$() is the mobile, durability-limited version.
If you only want vanilla behaviour, craft the plain $(item)Sponge on a Stick$(): it soaks water only and turns wet, and you dry it back out in a furnace.
